threat_event: Memory-scraping malware on legacy park kiosks captures card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 96 kiosks and carts on the legacy POS shared with Hotels
existing_controls: P2PE at 334 of 430 points of sale
treatment_plan: Vendor through PAM; replace kiosks with cloud POS before the 2027 season (group plan GR-01)

threat_event: An attacker crosses the maintenance jump host into ride control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Jump host bridges business and ride networks at 2 parks
treatment_plan: Remove the bridge; PAM for ride vendors (group plan GR-09)
owner: Attractions vice president of ride engineering

threat_event: Children's data in the kids' club is exposed without the required security program
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written children's information security program (312.8(b)); no annual risk assessment for children's data
treatment_plan: Written program; coordinator; annual assessment; testing

threat_event: Children's game activity is disclosed to an analytics vendor without separate parental consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One email consent covers collection and third-party disclosure
treatment_plan: Stop the feed until separate consent exists; written vendor assurances

threat_event: Finger-scan templates held by the gate vendor are breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 640,000 templates kept with no deletion after pass expiry
treatment_plan: Delete templates 30 days after expiry; retention clause; annual vendor assurance
owner: Attractions vice president of park operations

threat_event: Skimming script on a park ticket microsite captures card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 microsites without script inventory or tamper detection
treatment_plan: Extend inventory and tamper detection to all pages that embed the payment form

threat_event: The ticketing and gate platform fails on a peak day
treatment_plan: Contract recovery objectives; peak-day failover test
owner: Attractions vice president of park operations

threat_event: Ticket bots buy dated tickets and passes for resale
Precise location data from the park app is exposed
Dynamic ticket prices are shown without mandatory fees for covered event tickets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Part 464 does not define live-event tickets; concert add-ons show base prices first
existing_controls: Total price on main ticket pages
treatment_plan: Total price on every ticket display as a precaution; counsel to confirm scope

threat_event: Seasonal staff keep access after their season ends
treatment_plan: HR end dates required at hire

threat_event: A denial-of-service attack disrupts ticket sales
A hurricane closes the Florida destination resort
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 parks and 3 resort hotels in one area
treatment_plan: Joint hurricane exercise with Hotels (group plan GR-15)
owner: Attractions vice president of park operations

threat_event: An AI applicant screening tool for seasonal hiring is deployed without review
regulatory_driver: Colorado SB26-189 (employment decisions, if used for Colorado applicants); 11 CCR 7200 (ADMT, California)
treatment_plan: Not approved; re-assessment required before any pilot (P10)

threat_event: Ride engineering workstations miss security patches
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Workstations patched only in the off-season
treatment_plan: Quarterly patch windows agreed with ride engineering
owner: Attractions vice president of ride engineering

threat_event: Stored-value cards and gift cards are defrauded
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gift card balance checks without rate limits
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Attractions security and compliance lead
